<!-- markdownlint-disable -->

## Overview

On ROCm, Muse Spark keeps the full residual stream on every TP rank, and each rank repeats the per-token work between the attention and MoE collectives for all tokens, namely the norm, squeeze and expand. This PR splits the residual stream by tokens across the TP ranks for large forwards, controlled by an environment flag `VLLM_ROCM_MUSE_SP_MIN_TOKENS`. The all-reduces become reduce-scatters and all-gathers, and the per-token work runs on each rank's sharded tokens only.

Currently the base of this PR is the ROCm enablement branch `muse-spark-rocm-support`, and will be rebased to target main once #62622 is merged.

<!-- Summarize the change in 1-2 lines. Link relevant issues and PRs. -->

## Claims

- For Muse Spark Open (amd/Muse-Spark-Open-816B-A42B-Quark-MXFP4) on MI355X, this achieves ~2.0% - ~8.7% throughput gain at TP8+EP8 and ~5.9% - ~15.7% at TP8 across concurrencies, with ~15% lower TTFT at TP8+EP8 and ~22-26% at TP8
- End-to-end accuracy is measured unchanged

<!-- State the accomplishments in a few concrete bullets: speedups, feature support, bug fixes, etc. -->

## Validation

<details>
<summary>serving command</summary>

```
VLLM_ROCM_USE_AITER=1 \
VLLM_ROCM_MUSE_MOE_REDUCE_DTYPE=bf16 \
VLLM_USE_BREAKABLE_CUDAGRAPH=1 \
vllm serve amd/Muse-Spark-Open-816B-A42B-Quark-MXFP4 \
  --tensor-parallel-size 8 --enable-expert-parallel `# omitted for TP8` \
  --dtype bfloat16 --language-model-only \
  --attention-backend ROCM_AITER_FA \
  --compilation-config '{"cudagraph_mode":"FULL_AND_PIECEWISE"}' \
  --no-enable-prefix-caching --enable-chunked-prefill \
  --max-model-len 32768 --max-num-seqs 128 --max-num-batched-tokens 8192 \
  --gpu-memory-utilization 0.90 \
  --reasoning-parser muse --enable-auto-tool-choice --tool-call-parser muse
```

</details>

<details>
<summary>benchmark command</summary>

```
# 8192/1024, CONC in 8 16 32 64
vllm bench serve --model amd/Muse-Spark-Open-816B-A42B-Quark-MXFP4 --backend vllm \
  --dataset-name random --random-input-len 8192 --random-output-len 1024 \
  --max-concurrency "$CONC" --num-prompts $((CONC * 4)) --temperature 0 --ignore-eos --seed 0
```

</details>

<details>
<summary>lm_eval command</summary>

```
lm_eval run --model local-completions \
  --model_args "model=amd/Muse-Spark-Open-816B-A42B-Quark-MXFP4,base_url=http://localhost:8000/v1/completions,num_concurrent=64,max_retries=3,timeout=600,tokenized_requests=False,tokenizer_backend=None" \
  --tasks gsm8k --num_fewshot 5 --batch_size 1
```

</details>

| 8192/1024 | 64 | PR | 18,087.38 | +8.74 | 1.9626 | +8.74 | 2,009.71 | +8.74 | 2,587.8 | -15.82 | 29.23 | -7.33 | 29.23 | -7.33 |

(main is the ROCm enablement branch)

<!-- Show evidence that the claims are met by this change, and steps to reproduce validations. -->

## Details

In a Muse Spark decoder layer with TP attention, the ranks exchange data in two places: the all-reduce after `o_proj`, and the reduction of the MoE output. Everything in between, RMSNorm, gated residual update, router, squeeze and expand, works on one token at a time, but every rank runs it on all `T` tokens. At TP8, 7/8 of them is repeated work that other ranks require that they already have.

This PR keeps only a slice of the tokens on each rank when forwards have at least `VLLM_ROCM_MUSE_SP_MIN_TOKENS` tokens (1024 by default). The collectives are changed accordingly:

| layer | main | PR |
|---|---|---|
| before attention | — | all-gather |
| after `o_proj` | all-reduce | reduce-scatter |
| before the experts | — | all-gather of the projected input and the router logits |
| after the experts, TP+EP | all-reduce | reduce-scatter |
| after the experts, TP-sharded | reduce-scatter of the route rows + all-gather (8 of each chunk) | one reduce-scatter of all route rows |

An all-reduce moves the same bytes as a reduce-scatter all-gather combination, and the extra cost is collective launches. Under EP there are three more per layer, which take ~0.12 ms at 8k tokens, while working per-token saves ~0.84 ms. Below ~1k tokens the extra launch latency costs about as much as the sharding saves, so the sharding threshold is set to 1024 by default so that smaller forwards keep the current path. That includes decode and every CUDA-graph-captured batch. `o_proj` and, under EP, the MoE layer are built with `reduce_results=False` when sharding is possible, and do the same reduction in `forward` as before when a forward is not sharded.

The change is limited to the ROCm Muse Spark path. It is enabled with TP > 1 and either expert parallelism or a bf16 MoE reduction, and requires DP = PP = PCP = DCP = 1. It can be set by `VLLM_ROCM_MUSE_SP_MIN_TOKENS`, and setting it `=0` turns it off.

AI agent was used for this PR.

@@ -0,0 +1,54 @@
+# SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
+# SPDX-FileCopyrightText: Copyright contributors to the vLLM project
+"""MuseSpark1x ROCm token-sharded residual stream: row ownership and collectives."""
+
+import pytest
+import ray
+import torch
+
+from vllm.platforms import current_platform
+
+from ..utils import (
+    ensure_model_parallel_initialized,
+    init_test_distributed_environment,
+    multi_gpu_test,
+    multi_process_parallel,
+)
+
+pytestmark = pytest.mark.skipif(
+    not current_platform.is_rocm(), reason="MuseSpark1x ROCm model path"
+)
+
+
+@ray.remote(num_gpus=1, max_calls=1)
+def token_shard_round_trip(
+    monkeypatch: pytest.MonkeyPatch, tp_size, pp_size, rank, distributed_init_port
+) -> None:
+    with monkeypatch.context() as m:
+        m.delenv("CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES", raising=False)
+        m.delenv("HIP_VISIBLE_DEVICES", raising=False)
+        device = torch.device(f"cuda:{rank}")
+        torch.accelerator.set_device_index(device)
+        init_test_distributed_environment(tp_size, pp_size, rank, distributed_init_port)
+        ensure_model_parallel_initialized(tp_size, pp_size)
+        from vllm.models.muse_spark.amd.model import TokenShard
+
+        for num_tokens in (1, 5, 16, 1027):
+            full = torch.arange(num_tokens * 64, device=device) % 61
+            full = full.view(num_tokens, 64).to(torch.bfloat16)
+            shard = TokenShard(num_tokens)
+            local = shard.local(full)
+            assert local.shape == (shard.rows, 64)
+            owned = full[shard.start : shard.start + shard.rows]
+            torch.testing.assert_close(local[: owned.shape[0]], owned, atol=0, rtol=0)
+            assert not local[owned.shape[0] :].any()
+            torch.testing.assert_close(shard.gather(local), full, atol=0, rtol=0)
+            summed = shard.reduce_scatter(full * (rank + 1))
+            expected = shard.local(full * sum(range(1, tp_size + 1)))
+            torch.testing.assert_close(summed, expected)
+
+
+@multi_gpu_test(num_gpus=2)
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("tp_size", [2])
+def test_muse_spark_token_shard(monkeypatch: pytest.MonkeyPatch, tp_size: int) -> None:
+    multi_process_parallel(monkeypatch, tp_size, 1, token_shard_round_trip)

@@ -405,7 +405,12 @@ def test_finalize_is_chunk_invariant() -> None:
     (_moe_config(parallel_config=_parallel_config(sp_size=2)), "sequence"),
     (_moe_config(parallel_config=_parallel_config(enable_eplb=True)), "EPLB"),
     (_moe_config(is_lora_enabled=True), "LoRA"),
-    (_moe_config(skip_final_all_reduce=True), "unreduced"),
+    (
+        _moe_config(
+            parallel_config=_parallel_config(tp_size=8), skip_final_all_reduce=True
+        ),
+        "unreduced",
+    ),
 ]
 
 
@@ -426,6 +431,15 @@ def test_unsupported_deployments_fail_closed(
         validate(config)
 
 
+def test_expert_parallel_moe_may_leave_the_final_reduce_to_the_model() -> None:
+    config = _moe_config(
+        parallel_config=_parallel_config(ep_size=8), skip_final_all_reduce=True
+    )
+    validate_bf16_deployment(config)
+    validate_fp8_deployment(config)
+    validate_mxfp4_deployment(config)
+
+
 @pytest.mark.parametrize(
     "tp_size,ep_size,reduced", [(1, 1, False), (8, 1, True), (1, 4, False)]
 )
@@ -963,6 +977,51 @@ def _all_gather(x: torch.Tensor, dim: int = -1) -> torch.Tensor:
     assert torch.count_nonzero(actual[3:]) == 0
 
 
+@pytest.mark.skipif(not ROCM_AVAILABLE, reason="requires a ROCm GPU")
+def test_token_sharded_stream_keeps_only_the_current_ranks_finalized_rows(
+    monkeypatch,
+) -> None:
+    torch.manual_seed(0)
+    num_tokens, top_k, hidden = 8, 8, 256
+    norm = _post_expert_norm_module(hidden).cuda()
+    routed = torch.randn(num_tokens, top_k, hidden, device="cuda", dtype=torch.bfloat16)
+    weights = torch.softmax(torch.randn(num_tokens, top_k, device="cuda"), dim=-1)
+    ids = torch.zeros(num_tokens, top_k, dtype=torch.int32, device="cuda")

+    __slots__ = ("num_tokens", "rows", "start", "world")
